payload.description: A fresh AI-made desktop wallpaper every morning, one picture for each of your monitors. Every morning, one of your Agents writes a prompt from a theme you choose, your PC paints a picture for each monitor, and Windows shows it as your desktop. You can keep, reject, rate or re-roll any picture, and rejected ideas are not repeated. It is not Ambience, which only changes the background inside Leaf. This one changes your Windows desktop.
